title: Determinants of protein corona adsorption and abundance revealed by interpretable machine learning across nanoparticle systems.
summary: Interpretable deep neural networks were used to predict protein-corona adsorption and relative abundance across nanoparticle systems. The paper reports an analysis of protein-corona patterns; its computational predictions are not experimental validation of downstream therapeutic or biological effects. The result is reported in the Scientific Reports. The study does not establish generalization beyond its reported setting or prospective real-world benefit. Affiliation was not stated in the reviewed material.
